display_name: Mary, niece of Abraham the Recluse

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 octombrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Avramie și Maria, nepoata sa».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Αβράμιος και Μαρία η ανεψιά του», with the rank word left off.
Read out of the title on her name link behind the line for 29 октября ст. ст., «Мария Хиданская, прп.», with the rank word left off. The line itself declines the name and gives no village.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 29. октобар ст. ст., „Преп. Аврамије Затворник и синовица му Марија.“ — the heading’s only rank word, «Преп.», governs her uncle, and what it gives her is «синовица му», his niece, which is a DESCRIPTION of her and not part of her name; it also names another saint, which section 6 keeps out of a stored form in any case. So the bare forename is the whole of what is left and there is nothing in the heading to break a fold with. `foldchk.py` finds the string on five folders, so the form joins a fold of six, keyed in `READ_FOLDS` in the same commit. The corpus’s own precedent for this exact shape is `anastasia-of-serbia`, whose heading read «Преподобна Анастасија, мајка Светог Саве».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Аврамия затворника и блж. Марии , племянницы его (ок. 360).»
source.note: The line is the second of the day and carries no typikon icon, so no rank is recorded. The line's word for her is «блж.», blessed, where it calls her uncle «прп.», venerable; her own name link titles her «Мария Хиданская, прп.», venerable, so the two disagree and neither is read into `types`, which keep the `ascetic` the Romanian page gave her.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the Romanian and Greek days this folder was written from, names the village — «Мария Хиданская», of Hidana — and gives the folder the first date it has had. It is the uncle's year that the line prints; her own is five years later by the life's own words, and the folder's interval says so and is marked `inferred` for that reason.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 29 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Avramie și Maria, nepoata sa»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Αβράμιος και Μαρία η ανεψιά του»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the woman is the folder's own: «Οσια Μαρια η Ανεψια Του Οσιου Αβραμιου», the brother's daughter whom Abramius drew out of her sin. saint.gr gives no year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. Both hymns on the page name Abramius and not Mary, so none is taken into this folder; the epigram over her name, «Ἀφεῖσα σαρκὸς τοὺς ἐραστὰς Μαρία, ψυχῶν ἐραστῇ μυστικῶς περιπλέκῃ», is quoted in the life instead. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.11.2025 (29. октобар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Аврамије Затворник и синовица му Марија.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, the second of the two people it enumerates: «Преп. Аврамије Затворник и синовица му Марија» — and his niece Mary. The heading NAMES her, which is what earns her a row of her own under the brief’s enumeration ruling; the row quotes the whole heading, the same string the `abraham-the-recluse` row carries. `types` UNTOUCHED, AND THE RANK WORD DOES NOT REACH HER. «Преп.» governs Аврамије, and what the heading gives her instead is a relationship, «синовица му» — his niece. So no `venerable` was added, and the `ascetic` this folder already holds is left as it is. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE BOOK SAYS NOTHING ABOUT HER DEATH. The folder holds `death` 360 to 370, «about 365», basis `inferred`, because no page prints a year for her and the Russian calendar gives the pair her uncle’s «(ок. 360)». THIS ENTRY GIVES HER NO YEAR EITHER — its one date, 360, is explicitly Abraham’s repose — so the inference stands exactly as it was and nothing here strengthens or weakens it. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS ONE CLAUSE. She is the reason for the SECOND of the only two occasions on which her uncle left his cell in fifty years: he came out «да спасе своју заблуделу синовицу Марију», to save his strayed niece Mary. That is the whole of what this book says of her, and it is said about him; the straying itself, the inn, the disguise and the rescue are in the other three books and not in this one. The life says so. NO NEW `related`: `abraham-the-recluse` is already related both ways and is linked in the new paragraph. No `office`, no `locations`. THE FORM FOLDS WIDE AND THE FOLD IS KEYED. The bare «Марија» is already held by five folders — `maria-of-caesarea`, `mary-called-marinos`, `mary-of-tarsus`, `mary-sister-of-lazarus` and `mary-wife-of-xenophon` — so this form takes the key to SIX, the widest fold of this six-day block. There is nothing in the heading to break it with: «синовица му» is a description of her and not part of her name, and it names another saint besides, which section 6 keeps out of a stored form in any case. That is the identical shape as `anastasia-of-serbia`’s «Преподобна Анастасија, мајка Светог Саве», whose key this corpus already carries. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and is about Abraham.

death.note: No page prints a year for her. days.pravoslavie.ru's line gives the pair «(ок. 360)», which is her uncle's death — its life closes him «отошел ко Господу († около 360 года)» — and then says of her «Скончалась она через пять лет после преподобного Аврамия», five years after him. The display is that arithmetic and is labelled `inferred` because it is arithmetic and not a year any page prints; the bounds are kept wide enough to hold the «около» on both halves of it.
